title: Build signup/login pages with Auth.js integration
acceptance_criteria: Login page at /auth/login with email/password form and 'Sign in with Google' button
Signup page at /auth/signup with email/password form and Google OAuth option
Forms use server actions or client-side fetch to Auth.js callbacks
Login errors displayed inline (invalid credentials, account not found)
After login, redirect to /dashboard (existing users) or /onboarding (new signups)
Password visibility toggle, form validation, and loading states
Responsive at all breakpoints, follows design workflow
